issue.title: Retire #now: sticky Next/Pending lanes and a ledger-derived Today
issue.description: Linking a task makes it Next, working it makes it Pending, and no unlink path (hooks, keymap, capture drop, hand deletion) ever lowers it; only an explicit one-key release returns it to Ready. Today is read from the ledger when the dash renders, the dash shows mutually exclusive TODAY / PENDING / NEXT / READY sections with soft caps, and #now is gone from bob-cli, bob-plugins, Bob Mac Capture, the vault, and memory.
